_comment: De-identification gold standard. ENTIRELY SYNTHETIC: every name, village,
phone number and register number below was invented for this file. No real
patient, relative, clinician or facility is represented.
The split that matters is `onRoster`. An identifier the device already holds
is findable by exact match, and the deterministic scrub gets 100% of those at
zero megabytes. An identifier the roster does NOT hold, a relative named in
passing, a referring clinician, a neighbouring village, is invisible to exact
matching by construction. That second set is the entire case for spending
67 MB on a neural pass, so the harness reports the two separately: a combined
recall number would hide exactly the thing being measured.
`roster` is the patient list the device is assumed to hold when scrubbing.
`identifiers` are the substrings that MUST be gone from the output.
`mustKeep` are clinical terms that must SURVIVE: a scrubber that redacts
everything scores 100% recall and destroys the record, so precision is
measured against these rather than left implicit.

cases.notes: The dominant leak: the patient's own name in their own note. Exact match handles it.
cases.text: Patiente RAKOTOARISOA revue ce jour pour fièvre persistante.

cases.notes: Notes routinely reference relatives who are themselves registered.
cases.text: Frère de ANDRIANJAFY, même symptomatologie, toux sèche.

cases.notes: A fokontany of a few hundred people plus an age and a sex identifies someone. HIPAA Safe Harbor removes geography below state level for the same reason.
cases.text: Vit au village Ambohimanga, marche deux heures pour venir.

cases.notes: Malagasy mobile, written in the usual groups. Pattern-matched, not roster-matched.
cases.text: Joindre la famille au 034 12 345 67 si aggravation.

cases.notes: Too short for the long-digit rule; a direct key back into the paper file.
cases.text: Dossier 2041 retrouvé, antécédent de paludisme en 2025.

cases.notes: THE CASE FOR THE MODEL. 'Hanta' is a real identifier and no roster lookup will ever find her: she is not a patient here.
cases.text: Accompagnée par sa fille Hanta, qui rapporte une fièvre depuis trois jours.

cases.notes: A referring clinician's name identifies the patient by narrowing the catchment to one practice.
cases.text: Adressée par le Docteur Ramanantsoa du CSB de Manjakandriana.

cases.notes: A village nobody on this roster lives in is still identifying, and still invisible to exact matching.
cases.text: Résidence habituelle Ambodivona, déplacée chez un parent depuis un mois.

cases.notes: Both kinds in one sentence, which is the realistic case. The deterministic pass should get one and miss the other.
cases.text: RAZAFIMAHATRATRA accompagné de son voisin Solofo, tous deux fébriles.

cases.notes: No identifiers whatsoever. Any redaction here is a false positive against clinical content.
cases.text: Fièvre depuis trois jours, paludisme simple confirmé au test rapide, traitement débuté.

cases.notes: Age is clinical content: it drives the WHO/IMCI bands the DHIS2 report is disaggregated by, and is capped structurally elsewhere. Redacting it damages the record.
cases.text: Enfant de 6 ans, poids 18 kg, diarrhée aiguë sans déshydratation.

cases.notes: Drug names look like proper nouns to a NER model. Redacting them would be catastrophic and is the most likely false-positive mode.
cases.text: Artéméther luméfantrine matin et soir, paracétamol si fièvre, revoir dans trois jours.
